new_libraries.name: NLTP
new_libraries.author: Amandeep Bains
new_libraries.sentence: Loss-resilient forward-secret encrypted UDP & ESP-NOW v1/v2 transport with LZ4 compression & 4.7 KB TX-only MCU profile.
new_libraries.paragraph: Wire-compatible with the Python, JS, and Java nltp SDKs. Combines GF(2^8) Cauchy forward error correction, built-in zero-dependency LZ4 block compression, ultra-light 4.7 KB RAM NLTP_TX_ONLY sensor mode, reliable out-of-line reflex commands, BBR-style delivery-rate pacing, X25519+PSK forward-secret ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption with 512-packet anti-replay protection, NAT keepalives, and zero-knowledge CGNAT relay rooms in zero-float C99.
